verdict.rationale: Mercury is a banking/fintech platform that itself exposes an MCP server (mcp.mercury.com) for AI agents to consume its financial tools — it is not an agentic host application where users plug in arbitrary external MCP servers for it to consume. This story's axis (acting as an MCP client/host of third-party tool servers) is a category mismatch for a financial services platform rather than an agent or IDE-like tool.
